title: Privacy
description: How Advice4you uses and protects your personal information.
content:
Privacy policy

Last updated: 2026-10-11

Who we are

Advice4you is a service based in Norwich, United Kingdom. We are responsible for the personal information you share with us. You can contact us about privacy using the details on our contact page.

This website

This website does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. It does not have a contact form. Your browser stores your language choice and your cookie choice on your own device. Our hosting provider keeps short technical logs, such as IP addresses, to keep the website secure and working.

When you contact us

When you message, call or email us, we receive your name, your contact details and what you tell us about your situation. Some of this may be sensitive, such as health or immigration details. We only ask for what we need to help you.

Why we use your information

We use your information to answer you, to give you the help you ask for and to keep a record of the work we do together. Our legal bases under UK GDPR are your request for our service, our legitimate interest in running the service, and, for sensitive information, your explicit consent.

Who we share it with

We do not sell your information. We only share it with an office or organisation when you ask us to, or when the law requires it. If you contact us by WhatsApp, WhatsApp also processes your messages under its own privacy policy.

How long we keep it

We keep your information only as long as we need it to help you and to meet our legal duties. After that we delete it securely.

Your rights

You can ask to see the information we hold about you, ask us to correct it or delete it, and object to how we use it. If you are not happy with how we handle your information, you can complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk.
